groups.why_chosen: A key frame runs full 3DGS mapping and records each Gaussian's non-contributory pixel count; as long as covisibility stays high, later non-key frames reuse that record to skip the same low-contribution Gaussians, until falling covisibility forces a fresh key frame.
groups.what_to_learn: three time-ordered columns sharing one template (photo -> mapping arrow -> annotated scene -> data table); a small worked data table whose flagged rows are cross-referenced by colour into the diagram above it; a feedback arrow carrying one frame's recorded values into the next frame's decision
